name: Foreign Exchange Trade Status And Details Notification V 06
definition: Scope||The ForeignExchangeTradeStatusAndDetails message is sent by a central system to the participant to provide notification of the status and details of a foreign exchange trade.||Usage||The notification is sent by a central settlement system to the two trading parties after it has received foreign exchange trade instructions from both.

StatusDetails.name: Status Details
StatusDetails.definition: Provides information on the status of a foreign exchange trade in the central system.

TradeInformation.name: Trade Information
TradeInformation.definition: General information related to the foreign exchange trade.

TradingSideIdentification.name: Trading Side Identification
TradingSideIdentification.definition: Party(ies) on the trading side of the foreign exchange trade.

CounterpartySideIdentification.name: Counterparty Side Identification
CounterpartySideIdentification.definition: Party(ies) on the counterparty side of the foreign exchange trade.

TradeAmounts.name: Trade Amounts
TradeAmounts.definition: Amounts of the foreign exchange trade.

AgreedRate.name: Agreed Rate
AgreedRate.definition: Exchange rate as agreed by the traders.

NonDeliverableForwardConditions.name: Non Deliverable Forward Conditions
NonDeliverableForwardConditions.definition: Provides the opening and fixing information for an NDF trade.

TradingSideSettlementInstructions.name: Trading Side Settlement Instructions
TradingSideSettlementInstructions.definition: Settlement instructions for the amounts received by the trading side.

CounterpartySideSettlementInstructions.name: Counterparty Side Settlement Instructions
CounterpartySideSettlementInstructions.definition: Settlement instructions for the amounts received by the counterparty.

GeneralInformation.name: General Information
GeneralInformation.definition: Additional Information about the foreign exchange trade.

RegulatoryReporting.name: Regulatory Reporting
RegulatoryReporting.definition: Information that is to be provided to trade repositories in the context of the regulatory standards around over-the-counter (OTC) derivatives, central counterparties and trade repositories.

PostTradeEvent.name: Post Trade Event
PostTradeEvent.definition: Information relating to post-trade lifecycle events.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.

SplitTradeFalsePresenceRule.definition: If TradeInformation\SplitTradeIndicator is NO (‘false’), the SplitTradeInformation is not allowed.

SplitTradeTruePresenceRule.definition: If TradeInformation\SplitTradeIndicator is YES (‘true’), the SplitTradeInformation must be present.
